name: Sentinel (Copernicus)
description: Europe's flagship Earth-observation programme, operated by ESA on behalf of the European Commission's Copernicus environmental-monitoring service. Sentinel-1 (C-band SAR radar imaging), Sentinel-2 (multispectral optical at 10-60 m), Sentinel-3 (ocean + land), Sentinel-5P (atmospheric chemistry), Sentinel-6 (altimetry). All in sun-synchronous LEO. Free + open data policy — every Sentinel image is downloadable without licensing fees.
